claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 accurately captures the requirement from paragraph (a) that the employer must ensure the ready availability of medical personnel for advice and consultation on matters of plant health.

Claim C0001 faithfully represents the first sentence of paragraph (b), mandating first-aid trained personnel in the absence of a near-proximity infirmary, clinic, or hospital treating all injured employees.
Claim C0002 faithfully reflects the second sentence of paragraph (b), requiring that adequate first aid supplies shall be readily available.
Claim C0003 faithfully captures paragraph (c), requiring suitable facilities for quick drenching or flushing of eyes and body where exposure to injurious corrosive materials may occur.
Claim C0004 captures the recommendation in Appendix A that contents listed in ANSI Z308.1-1998 should be adequate for small worksites.

Claim C0005 accurately states the recommendation in Appendix A that employers conducting larger or multiple operations at the same location should determine the need for additional kits, equipment, and supplies.
Claim C0006 correctly states the descriptive possibility noted in Appendix A that employers with unique or changing first-aid needs may need to enhance their first-aid kits.
Claim C0007 correctly captures the permission/option that employers can use OSHA logs or other reports to identify unique first-aid problems.
Claim C0008 accurately states that consultation from fire/rescue, medical professionals, or emergency rooms may be helpful to employers in these circumstances.
Claim C0009 accurately captures the advisory statement that employers can ensure reasonably anticipated supplies are available by assessing workplace needs.
Claim C0010 accurately reflects the recommendation that employers should periodically assess worksite needs and augment first aid kits appropriately.
Claim C0011 accurately reflects the mandatory requirement to provide PPE complying with § 1910.1030(d)(3) if exposure to blood or OPIM is reasonably anticipated while using first aid supplies.
Claim C0012 accurately captures the descriptive statement listing examples of appropriate PPE under the referenced bloodborne pathogens standard.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 completely and accurately retains the duty under § 1910.151(a).
Claim C0001 completely retains the requirement and full condition for trained first aid personnel under § 1910.151(b).
Claim C0002 fully retains the requirement that adequate first aid supplies be readily available under § 1910.151(b).
Claim C0003 preserves the full duty, conditions, and location requirements for eye/body flushing facilities under § 1910.151(c).
No claim in the draft was created to represent the introductory statements of Appendix A regarding § 1910.151(b) and ANSI Z308.1-1998 as an example of minimal generic kit contents.
Claim C0004 faithfully captures the advisory statement that ANSI Z308.1-1998 kit contents should be adequate for small worksites.
Claim C0005 fully retains the recommendation for determining additional kits, equipment, and supplies for larger or multiple operations.
Claim C0006 fully captures the statement concerning employers with unique or changing first-aid needs potentially needing to enhance kits.
Claim C0007 completely preserves the permission to use OSHA 300/301 logs or other reports to identify unique problems.
Claim C0008 covers the statement that consultation with emergency/medical professionals may be helpful.
Claim C0009 captures the statement that assessing workplace needs can ensure reasonably anticipated supplies are available.
Claim C0010 faithfully preserves the recommendation to assess needs periodically and augment kits appropriately.
Claim C0011 covers the requirement to provide PPE in compliance with § 1910.1030(d)(3) when blood/OPIM exposure is anticipated while using first aid supplies.
Claim C0012 captures the descriptive enumeration of PPE listed in the bloodborne pathogens standard.
